title: 1997 Topps #489 Prospects Paul Konerko Derrek Lee Ron Wright UER Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1997 Topps #489 Prospects: Paul Konerko (Los Angeles Dodgers), Derrek Lee (San Diego Padres) and Ron Wright (Pittsburgh Pirates). Error card (UER): the back spells Lee's name "Derek".

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
